limitations: Mouse ownership, settings UI, and rebinding are not implemented.
Third-person live collision queries and visual filtering remain future work.
Movement/combat alignment, interaction, death, scene travel, and long soaks are not covered.
Only the supplied standard Exanima executable is accepted; EMTK, ExanimaLua, Hellmode, and other builds are not covered.
Pivot and near-plane corner logic is implemented and validated for the tested static-level scenes; a dedicated live shoulder/corner-only obstruction has not been isolated.
Ground protection, actual doorway traversal, dynamic-object policies, and combat interaction remain open.

The central-boom baseline measured 273.5009 microseconds per query; the pivot/frustum path commonly uses six grid queries per camera sample and measured 647.6174 microseconds per sample in the test room. Full performance acceptance remains open.
Historical counter bursts did not reproduce in the instrumented baseline session; longer play soaks are still required.
Other builds, EMTK/ExanimaLua coexistence, and scene travel are not covered.
Settings persistence, rebinding, FOV controls, and controller input are not implemented.
Death, scene travel, resolution changes, inventory/shops/dialogue, and long soaks remain future acceptance work.
